purpose: Choose handling for .DS_Store corpus extras (corrected requirements schema after d002 validation error)

arguments.decision: How should the format verifier handle Finder-created .DS_Store files that appeared in the corpus after the last recorded pass?
arguments.evidence: Observed 2026-10-04: python3 tools/verify_formats.py corpus games/ford-racing-2 returned status=fail exit=1 with exactly two diagnostics: 'extraction path missing or additional: .DS_Store' and '... 3DDATA/.DS_Store'. Prior PASS run was at 01:34:56 local; the macOS Finder metadata files games/ford-racing-2/extracted/files/.DS_Store (and 3DDATA/.DS_Store) have mtimes 01:38:52, i.e. created AFTER that pass by Finder browsing. All 990 expected paths matched; hashes/count checks produced no other failure. corpus_contract.coverage() computes sorted(actual_paths.keys() ^ expected_paths.keys()) over files.rglob('*') and reports every difference as a failure. The directory is user-owned game corpus; Finder will recreate .DS_Store whenever the folder is viewed. Issue #2 requires: report all discovered inputs, never silently skip files, preserve exact case and ;1 suffixes, hashes identify corpus.
arguments.priorities: Never silently exclude discovered files to obtain a pass (issue #2). Preserve the user's working files and corpus; do not mutate game directories needlessly. A verifier should be robust against known OS metadata but every exclusion must be visible in the result. Smallest correct change with a public-seam regression test.

candidates.description: Delete the .DS_Store files from the corpus directory and rerun; leave verifier unchanged.

Change the corpus verifier to exclude only files whose basename is exactly .DS_Store from the extra-path comparison, and record each excluded path with its SHA-256 in the result as ignored OS metadata (visible, not silent); add a failing-then-passing CLI test showing .DS_Store is ignored and reported while any other extra file still fails.
Exclude all dot-files and hidden files from the comparison without reporting them.
Leave the verifier strict; report the formats check as failing until the user removes the Finder files.

requirements: Every excluded path remains visible in the result (not silent).
Does not delete or modify files in the user's game corpus.
